name: HODIE Feedback Model v1
principle: Feedback should improve the next attempt, not merely explain the previous one.

summary.when: A practice set or integrated demonstration ends.

A2.feedback: English first with Spanish explanation when useful

B1.feedback: English first; Spanish only when it materially improves understanding

retryRules.fluencyException: During fluent production, do not interrupt for low-impact form errors.
retryRules.afterRepeatedFailure: Switch activity type or reduce support before asking for the same response again.

correctionPrinciples: Do not overwhelm A2 learners with every possible error.
Do not treat a task constraint such as minimum characters as CEFR evidence.
When possible, make the learner produce the corrected form.
